subcriteria.name: Accuracy_and_Completeness
subcriteria.description: Apparent correctness, internal consistency, adequate coverage and necessary context without claiming source-grounded verification.

subcriteria.name: Logical_Flow
subcriteria.description: Coherent ordering, narrative progression and transitions.

subcriteria.name: Cognitive_Rhythm
subcriteria.description: Variation between dense information and lighter recovery or summary slides.

criteria.name: Visual_Design
criteria.description: Evaluate deck-level aesthetic quality, consistency, and professional appearance.

subcriteria.name: Color_Scheme
subcriteria.description: Harmony, contrast, palette balance, and unified color application.

subcriteria.name: Typography
subcriteria.description: Font readability, consistency, sizing, and hierarchy.

subcriteria.name: Visual_Consistency
subcriteria.description: Cross-slide consistency of color, motifs, style, and identity.

subcriteria.name: Image_Quality
subcriteria.description: Resolution, relevance, cropping, distortion, and integration.

subcriteria.name: Theme_Appropriateness
subcriteria.description: How well the visual theme matches topic and audience.

criteria.name: Layout
criteria.description: Evaluate deck-level spatial organization, balance, alignment, and readability.

subcriteria.name: Spatial_Balance
subcriteria.description: Whitespace, density, balance, and visual weight.

subcriteria.name: Element_Alignment
subcriteria.description: Alignment, spacing, grids, margins, and precision.

subcriteria.name: No_Overlapping
subcriteria.description: Absence of unintended collisions, clipping, occlusion, and overflow.

criteria.name: Complexity
criteria.description: Evaluate deck-level visual richness and sophistication without rewarding clutter.

subcriteria.name: Charts_and_Data
subcriteria.description: Quality of charts, tables, diagrams, and data communication.

subcriteria.name: Visual_Elements
subcriteria.description: Variety and integration of images, icons, illustrations, and graphics.

subcriteria.name: Advanced_Design
subcriteria.description: Depth, layering, custom graphics, effects, and sophisticated techniques.

subcriteria.name: Layout_Variety
subcriteria.description: Meaningful layout variation while retaining consistency.

criteria.name: Single_Slide_Quality
criteria.description: Evaluate the standalone execution quality of each individual slide.

subcriteria.name: Content_Clarity
subcriteria.description: Whether this slide communicates one understandable message with readable and appropriately concise content.

subcriteria.name: Visual_Effectiveness
subcriteria.description: Whether visible colors, typography, imagery, and hierarchy support this slide's message.

subcriteria.name: Layout_Execution
subcriteria.description: Whether this slide is balanced, aligned, unclipped, non-overlapping, and spatially coherent.
